jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer - Public Safety & Patrol Fort Worth
jobs.description:
Marksman Security Corporation is hiring an Unarmed Security Officer in Fort Worth. This role involves conducting patrols, engaging with the public, and responding to calls for service in a dynamic environment. Applicants should have a valid Texas Level II Guard License, be at least 21 years old, and possess strong communication skills.

This position may require working evenings, weekends, and holidays. The candidate must have one year of customer service and security experience, along with a high school degree or equivalent.

jobs.title: Weekend Unarmed Security Guard – Flexible PT (Level 2)
jobs.description:
Premier-Protective-Security is seeking Unarmed Level 2 Security Guards for a temporary part-time position in Haslet, TX. Candidates must possess an active Level 2 Security Guard license and be at least 18 years old. Responsibilities include maintaining a secure environment, enforcing regulations, and responding to incidents.

The position offers flexible schedules on weekends, specifically Saturday and Sunday, from 1pm to 9pm, with a pay rate of $17 per hour.
